# .github/workflows/main.yaml :: jobs > build_docs
  build_docs:
    name: Build docs
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, 'skip docs') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true
      - name: Init runner
        run: bash ./scripts/init_runner.sh ${{ github.job }}
      - name: Build docs
        run: bash ./scripts/build_docs.sh -p -r ${{ github.job }}
